title: Building JSON APIs
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of building json apis in a Ruby program and name the key rule involved.
Apply building json apis in a small example and predict its result before running it.
Identify one boundary or failure case related to api versioning and compatibility and verify the intended behavior.

content.intro: Learn Building JSON APIs through a visual model, a minimal Ruby example, and a practical check.
content.why_it_matters: Understanding building json apis helps you write code that is easier to explain, test, and maintain. It also helps separate Ruby language guarantees from runtime assumptions, dependency behavior, and application-specific rules.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Building JSON APIs helps you reason about json request and response handling. In Ruby, prefer a small example whose inputs and expected result are easy to explain. This lesson connects the syllabus topic to practical code and highlights where assumptions or edge cases matter.

content_blocks.title: How to think about it
content_blocks.text: Begin by identifying the key rule: JSON request and response handling. Then connect it to Serialization and response structure. The remaining syllabus points—Pagination and filtering, API versioning and compatibility—are useful checks before applying this in a larger project.

content_blocks.title: Guided example
